answers.why: The house of Levi identifies the man's tribal affiliation.
Levi is named as the father of the woman taken as wife.
Israel has elders who represent the people afflicted in Egypt.
The elders of Israel accompany Moses to request freedom for the Hebrews.
God's firstborn Israel is the people Pharaoh must release.
The God of Israel commands Pharaoh to release his people.
Pharaoh questions the command to let the Israelite people go.
Pharaoh refuses to release the Israelite people.
Israel is the father whose firstborn son is Reuben.
The families of Reuben are the clans constituting the Reubenite tribe.
The families of Simeon are the clans constituting the Simeonite tribe.
The verse gives Levi's personal lifespan as 137 years.
